units.title: Pre-Press Room Equipment
topics: 1.1. Introduction to offset image carrier.
1.2. Study of invention of lithography.
1.3. Study of lithographic principle.
1.4. Classification of plates analog and digital.
1.5. Different steps for offset plate making.
1.6. Pre-press room equipment: whirler, printing down frame, auto plate processor.
1.7. Study of surface treatment such as graining, anodizing, counter etching.
1.8. Photographic positive and negatives and their ideal optical and physical requirements for plate making techniques. Image Carrier Course Code: 4335803
uos: 1.a. Classify offset plates on the basis of construction and preparation.
1.b. Select workflow for plate preparation.
1.c. Explain the working of prepress room equipments.
1.d. Select appropriate film for plate preparation with justification.

units.title: Pre-Press Room Environment
topics: 2.1. Prepress room layout.
2.2. Environmental conditions.
2.3. Store room conditions and Storing Methods.
2.4. Dark reaction, continuing reaction, shelf life, pot life.
2.5. Room layout, ventilation, air conditioning, temperature and humidity, color, waste disposal.
uos: 2.a. Suggest layout having ergonomic arrangement and Ideal environmental condition in prepress room.
2.b. Explain effects of circumstantial reactions on plate preparation.
2.c. Evaluate environmental aspect of dark room.

units.title: Imposition Scheme
topics: 3.1. Imposition – definition and purpose.
3.2. Terms related with imposition schemes, page characteristics variation in imposition schemes according to binding styles i.e. center, side, loose leaf binding.
3.3. Introduction and working of plate Imposition Software.
uos: 3.a. Understand different types of imposition scheme and terms.
3.b. Select the relevant type of imposition scheme for given product binding.
3.c. Describe working of imposition software relevant to manual operations.

units.title: Plate Processing Chemicals
topics: 4.1. Study of chemical and physical properties.
4.2. General contents of coatings used in presensitized plate and CtP lithographic plate.
4.3. Imaging requirements of plates.
4.4. Raw material used in offset image carrier making.
4.5. Study of general contents and functions of chemicals as developer, gum arabic, plate finisher and deletion.
uos: 4.a. Explain properties of plate coatings
4.b. Select imaging technique for plate preparation according to coating.
4.c. Use of raw material for plate making.
4.d. Select the relevant chemicals for plate finishing or corrections in plate.

units.title: Pre- sensitized (PS) and Computer to Plate (CtP) Plate preparation
topics: 5.1. Study construction of different plate.
5.2. Working principle, spectral emission, characteristics and limitations of offset plates.
5.3. Light sources or illuminants such as metal halide, carbon arc mercury vapor, pulsed xenon, type of LASER.
5.4. PS positive/negative plates and its characteristics and workflow of PS plate.
5.5. CtP plates with its characteristics and workflow.
5.6. Thermal & violet plate, requirements of input for CtP.
5.7. Use of software for CtP.
5.8. CtP machine with its construction and working. Image Carrier Course Code: 4335803
uos: 5.a. Identify spectral emission requirements for plate exposing.
5.b. Describe construction of Illuminants used for plate exposing.
5.c. Explain the procedure for PS plate preparation.
5.d. Select workflow for type of CtP plate preparation.
5.e. Select input specifications for software to prepare CtP plate.
5.f. Describe construction and workflow of CtP machine types.
